Source: https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/notebooks/dashboards
Fetched: 2026-06-17

Main heading:
"You can create dashboards from Databricks notebook cell outputs to publish graphs and visualizations and share them in a presentation format across your organization."

== Two dashboard types ==

Notebook Dashboards:
- Reformat notebooks into presentations with content tied to cell outputs
- Shareable and schedulable like regular notebooks
- Create via cell menu: "Select Add to notebook dashboard >. If you select Add to new notebook dashboard, the new dashboard is automatically displayed."
- CRITICAL: "Content in notebook dashboards are tied to the output of notebook cells. If you clear the cell output, the dashboard content is also cleared."

AI/BI Dashboards:
- Databricks recommends these for organizational sharing
- "Only visualizations from SQL cells can be added to AI/BI dashboards."
- Create via cell menu: "Select Add to dashboard. In the Add to dashboard dialog, select Create a new dashboard or Add to existing dashboard."

== Dashboard features (notebook dashboards) ==

Sizing & Placement:
- Resize via corner handles: "To resize an item, click [corner resize icon] at the lower-right corner and move your cursor until the item is the size you want."
- Move items by clicking and dragging
- Two layout modes: "Stack" (aligned) or "Float" (free movement)

Titling:
- "Select the Settings icon [Gear fill icon]. The Configure Dashboard Element dialog appears. In the dialog, click Show Title, enter a title for the plot, and click Save."

Navigation:
- Dashboard icon (top right) displays all associated dashboards
- Users switch between notebook and dashboard views
- Hover over plots to access "new window" icon linking to source cells

Scheduling:
- "Click Schedule to create a scheduled job for the notebook that generates the dashboard plots."
- "View last successful run" shows latest results

Presentation Mode:
- "To present a dashboard, click Fullscreen. To return to the interactive dashboard, click Exit in the upper-left corner or press the Esc key."

Deletion:
- "Delete this dashboard" removes the dashboard entirely
